caption: The drawing consists of a geometric design composed of colored pencil shapes on a cream background. At the center is an eight-pointed star made of dark purple sections with crosshatch lines. Surrounding the star is a ring forming a rough octagon, colored blue with white dots and small star-like patterns. Outside the blue ring, there are four identical motifs, each resembling a flower or crown, composed of light pink and red sections with a checkered pattern and small red swirls. All motifs are symmetrically placed at the cardinal points. The design is enclosed within a grid of light gray squares, each filled with diagonal lines. In the lower right corner of the page, the words “To Joyce” are written in small, neat letters.
title: Patchwork Quilt Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
